[HV-R1 complete-verdict-prose part 7/34]
licit activation/rollback contract. Component mocks can be correct, but they do not prove that these production acceptance cases can run in the owning phase. Provide the exact phase and prerequisite binding for each criterion and distinguish H1 adapter tests from later server-launched/live-stream cases. This is an evidence/plan edit, not a request to lower or waive a gate.

Operator decisions: No new operator decision is needed to repair the findings. D-03 remains the existing, intentionally open architecture/plan approval decision. This DISAGREE grants no approval.

Per-requirement what-if pass (FR-MCP-HVPIPE prefix; corresponding TR/TEST mapping checked separately):
- 001: configuration replay and stale PATCH are covered; automatic reprobe and probe-versus-PATCH races fail F03/F04.
- 002: alias/submitter/author exclusion, round-robin restart and workspace isolation have named cases; no new defect beyond configuration qualification.
- 003: missing effort/barrier fail closed and repeated NONCE is named; launch/nonzero/shutdown probes and stale configuration fail F04/F05/F14.
- 004: turn/range/session boundaries, exclusion, over-limit and later turn arrival have named outcomes; no new scope-selection finding.
- 005: concurrent overlap and idempotent server replay are named; maximum legacy request id and cross-session plugin invocation fail F20.
- 006: unresolved/malformed reference and secret-context outcomes have criteria; no additional reference-extraction defect found.
- 007: before-launch, running, after-exit restart and competing worker traces reviewed; F14/F19/F21 leave run state and terminal safety gaps.
- 008: quiet producer, byte bursts, no time limit, cancel/close and host lifecycle reviewed; F01/F15/F19 fail, U02 leaves H1 real binding unproven.
- 009: reviewer failure, server failure, bounded attempts and triage outage reviewed; F05/F08 fail probe and audit-hard-stop paths.
- 010: mixed verdicts, duplicate finalizers, incomplete/malformed records reviewed; F11/F13/F21 fail consistency and terminal replay.
- 011: corrupt/truncated/multi-member gzip and retained failed-attempt evidence have named tests; result hash projection fails F07.
- 012: pending/final immutability, migration and retry/rollback reviewed; F21 can overwrite successful completion through late failure.
- 013: self-review absent, passing, failing or changed has an explicit independence criterion for brief, admission and verdict; no new coupling found.
- 014: passing and failing verdicts are explicitly forbidden from changing TODO state; no verdict-to-TODO mutation found.
- 015: full result, delineated remediation and removed payload reads reviewed; F07/F11/F16 fail result projection and lifetime behavior.
- 016: event order/reconnect, quiet line and removed chunks reviewed; F01/F16 fail delivery or removal behavior.
- 017: disconnect/replay, crash during local writes, fast completion and prompt acknowledgment reviewed; F02 fails durability/delivery claims.
- 018: every mutation, read audit, outage and retention reviewed; F08 violates the no-write hard stop.
- 019: explicit removal, repeat removal, audit survival and subsequent reads reviewed; F16 leaves fields and payload-read outcomes incomplete.
- 020: REST/MCP/client/REPL/Director/plugin parity, unsupported hosts and session boundaries reviewed; F02/F20 and U02 affect plugin delivery and activation.
- 021: Mode Off, response reject/supersede during execution, empty/mixed findings and atomic grading reviewed; F10/F11/F12/F13 prevent the stated outcomes.

Verification scope: Full amendment and both live TODOs read end to end; source-pinned targeted foundation/live-code reads; object comparison of all selected store fields and mappings; probe hash/CLI help/version checks; read-only gh PR81 review checks; git history/hash/signature/ancestry and credential/format scans. All authored PowerShell files parsed and passed Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer Warning/Error before data runs; changed scripts were rechecked and receipt/session-write scripts were dry-run. No build or product suite was run for this documentation-only review; none is claimed green.
The requirement comparison has 63 records, 114 distinct FR behavior criteria and 42 edges in 21 mapping groups; Differences is empty. These are planned tests, not executed product tests.

My process deviations and limits:
- I initially included historical tool_result blocks when extracting the Cline user source. That copied a historical credential into my extraction receipt and tool output. I acknowledged it, redacted the affected reviewer-owned receipt and response JSONL, regenerated only genuine user text blocks, and left the original source unchanged. Prior tool output cannot be withdrawn; the runtime transcript outside this worktree is outside my write authorization. This limits my own no-secret compliance and is not an implementer finding.
- I accidentally ran one rg command without its intended explicit path, scanning local projections and logs. No TODO/requirement conclusion uses that output; all such conclusions use plugin reads. I added an explicit-path guard and stopped the broad command.
- Several shell invocations failed because of quoting, an initially wrong source path, or an early parsing expression. They made no product changes. Corrected commands and exact comparison results are recorded; failed commands are retained in the command evidence. Initial cache setup created an empty worktree failsafe directory before the override was set.
